title: Gotrade Daily: AMD Earnings Tonight, the AI-Chip Read
summary: AMD reports Q2 earnings tonight, a major test for the AI-chip trade. Tonight's watchlist: AMD, NVDA, AVGO, MU.
body_markdown:
Expectations are high. Analyst consensus points to revenue near $11.3 billion, up about 47% year on year, and earnings per share around $1.61, more than 235% higher YoY. Because AMD is treated as a barometer of AI-chip demand, the print can move sentiment across the whole sector.


## Tonight's Watchlist 📈


Stock Movement What to Watch


[AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) Monday close +0.8% Reports Q2 tonight; focus on MI350 shipments and Helios rack orders


[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) Monday close +2.9% AI-chip leader; AMD's result is a read on data-center demand


[AVGO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/avgo/) Monday close -0.2% Custom AI silicon and networking, sensitive to AI capex direction


[MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) Monday close +0.8% HBM memory supplier; HBM demand reported booked out through 2027


## Tonight's Catalysts 🧨


### AMD's Q2 print and the data-center engine


**AMD ([AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) )** puts its growth engine in the data-center segment, from EPYC server processors to Instinct AI accelerators. Investors will hunt for data-center revenue and gross margin, with the roughly 56% full-year gross-margin target under pressure from the Helios ramp. MI350 shipments and evidence of Helios rack orders will show whether the AI momentum is real.


### Read-through to Nvidia and the chip supply chain


As a bellwether, AMD's result often carries into **Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** , **Broadcom ([AVGO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/avgo/) )** , and memory suppliers like **Micron ([MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) )** . A strong demand signal can lift the entire AI-infrastructure complex, while any caution on pricing or supply can pressure the sector quickly.
